name: ViscElCapPhys
description: IPhys created from ViscElCapMat, for use with Law2_ScGeom_ViscElCapPhys_Basic.

attributes.name: Capillar
attributes.description: True, if capillar forces need to be added.

attributes.name: liqBridgeCreated
attributes.description: Whether liquid bridge was created, only after a normal contact of spheres

attributes.name: liqBridgeActive
attributes.description: Whether liquid bridge is active at the moment

attributes.name: sCrit
attributes.description: Critical bridge length [m]

attributes.name: Vb
attributes.description: Liquid bridge volume [m^3]

attributes.name: gamma
attributes.description: Surface tension [N/m]

attributes.name: theta
attributes.description: Contact angle [rad]

attributes.name: CapillarType
attributes.description: Different types of capillar interaction: Willett_numeric, Willett_analytic, Weigert, Rabinovich, Lambert, Soulie

attributes.name: dcap
attributes.description: Damping coefficient for the capillary phase [-]

attributes.name: cn
attributes.description: Normal viscous constant

attributes.name: cs
attributes.description: Shear viscous constant

attributes.name: Fn
attributes.description: Linear-elastic part of the normal force of the contact

attributes.name: Fv
attributes.description: Viscous part of the normal force of the contact

attributes.name: mR
attributes.description: Rolling resistance, see [Zhou1999536]_.

attributes.name: mRtype
attributes.description: Rolling resistance type, see [Zhou1999536]_. mRtype=1 - equation (3) in [Zhou1999536]_; mRtype=2 - equation (4) in [Zhou1999536]_

attributes.name: tangensOfFrictionAngle
attributes.description: tan of angle of friction

attributes.name: frictDissip
attributes.description: frictional energy dissipation in the contact (this value is updated by contact laws applicable to FrictPhys - currently only Law2_ScGeom_FrictPhys_CundallStrack) (auto-updated)

attributes.name: ks
attributes.description: Shear stiffness

attributes.name: shearForce
attributes.description: Shear force after previous step (in global coordinates), as sustained by particle #2 (from particle #1).

attributes.name: kn
attributes.description: Normal stiffness

attributes.name: normalForce
attributes.description: Normal force after previous step (in global coordinates), as sustained by particle #2 (from particle #1).

attributes.name: dispIndex
attributes.description: Return class index of this instance.

methods.name: dispHierarchy
methods.description: Return list of dispatch classes (from down upwards), starting with the class instance itself, top-level indexable at last. If names is true (default), return class names rather than numerical indices.

methods.name: updateAttrs
methods.description: Update object attributes from given dictionary
